scope: Original synthetic shape512 sampler, FP32 model tensors, ordinary flattened head-first RoPE, FP32 reciprocal attention. Only requested math fidelity differs. Distinct from result012 BF16-pipeline/stock-attention HiFi3 trial.
finding: On the identical FP32-tensor, flattened-RoPE shape512 sampler, HiFi3 final relative L2 is 0.301752 versus HiFi4 0.299911; runtime 16.895s versus 16.866s. Actual runtime IR confirms all457 learned linear/matmul operations use requested HiFi3/HiFi4 with FP32 accumulation and FP32 operands. Original12steps/21forwards, stock reference, physical checkpoint and model/helper sources match; no fallback or recompilation. The runtime warning motivated a test, not an assumed accuracy improvement.
decision: Reject HiFi3 as an accuracy fix on this FP32 fixture: final error is slightly higher, both original gate sets fail and measured runtime is essentially unchanged. Keep production defaults and stock gates; isolate native primitive errors on identical inputs before another complete sampler trial.
